description: This file contains the implementation of a lexical analyzer (CLexer) for PDF content streams within the PDFsharp library. It provides methods for tokenizing various PDF content stream syntax elements such as names, numbers, strings, dictionaries, and operators, enabling parsing and processing of PDF content streams.

classes.name: CLexer
classes.description: A lexical analyzer class for parsing PDF content streams, capable of tokenizing different syntax elements according to the PDF specification.

methods.name: ScanNextToken
methods.description: Reads the next token from the PDF content stream and determines its type.

methods.name: ScanComment
methods.description: Scans over a comment line in the PDF content stream.

methods.name: ScanInlineImage
methods.description: Scans the bytes of an inline image object within the content stream.

methods.name: ScanName
methods.description: Scans and returns a name object token in the PDF content stream.

methods.name: ScanDictionary
methods.description: Scans and returns a dictionary object token in the PDF content stream.

methods.name: ScanNumber
methods.description: Scans and returns a number token, which can be an integer, long, or real number.

methods.name: ScanOperator
methods.description: Scans and returns an operator token.

methods.name: ScanLiteralString
methods.description: Scans and returns a literal string token.

methods.name: ScanHexadecimalString
methods.description: Scans and returns a hexadecimal string token.

methods.name: ScanNextChar
methods.description: Advances the content stream position by one byte and returns the new current character.

methods.name: ClearToken
methods.description: Resets the current token being built.

methods.name: AppendAndScanNextChar
methods.description: Appends the current character to the token and advances to the next character.

methods.name: MoveToNonWhiteSpace
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next non-whitespace character.
